title: Ailytics and Safie Partner to Bring AI-Powered Industrial Safety to Japan and Beyond
summary: We're honored to partner with Safie for our Japan expansions and beyond!
description: Ailytics and Safie sign an MOU to bring AI-powered industrial safety to Japan and beyond, pairing Ailytics video analytics with Safie's cloud video platform.
html:
Singapore and Tokyo — 28 April, 2026 — Ailytics Pte Ltd ("Ailytics"), Singapore's leading AI video analytics platform for heavy industries, and Safie Inc. ("Safie"), Japan's leading cloud-based video management platform, today announced a strategic partnership through a signed Memorandum of Understanding (MOU).

The partnership combines Ailytics' industry-proven computer vision technology with Safie's cloud video infrastructure — creating an integrated solution that enables industrial operators to deploy AI-powered safety and compliance monitoring without replacing existing camera infrastructure.

Strategic Collaboration Areas
Through this MOU, Ailytics and Safie intend to explore several key areas of cooperation designed to enhance operational efficiency and customer value:

● Technology Integration & Innovation: Both parties will explore opportunities to align their respective technologies and platforms. The goal is to create integrated solutions that leverage the strengths of Ailytics’ video analytics alongside Safie’s cloud-based recording infrastructure.
● Joint Market Development: This partnership highlights Ailytics’ focus in entering the Japanese market, and together the companies will work together to identify additional market opportunities across geographic regions.
● Commercial & Reseller Collaboration: To better serve global customers, Ailytics and Safie will explore reseller, referral, or distribution arrangements. This may enable either party to offer the other’s specialized services as part of broader, comprehensive customer engagements.
● Pilot Projects and Demonstrations: The partnership will involve collaboration on pilot deployments and proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives. These joint projects will serve to validate the combined capabilities of their technologies in real-world industrial environments.

The signing ceremony was witnessed by Charlotte Lee, Director of Startup Ecosystem & Community of Enterprise Singapore, and Ms. Noriko Suzuki, Director of Promotion, Startup Strategy Promotion Headquarters of Tokyo Metropolitan Government.

Comment from Tan Wei Zhuang, CEO, Ailytics Pte Ltd.

"We started Ailytics to solve a problem every industrial operator faces: unsafe worksites and operational blind spots, despite having cameras everywhere. Our partnership with Safie is a natural next step, combining our proven AI analytics with Japan's most trusted cloud video platform to deliver something neither of us could offer alone.

 

Japan is a market we deeply respect, with world-class industrial standards and a strong culture of safety, and Safie is exactly the right partner to help us earn trust there. But this is bigger than Japan. Together, we see a path to making AI-powered industrial safety the global standard, starting in Asia and scaling globally. This MOU marks the beginning of that journey."

 

Comment from Tetsuharu Furuta, Director and COO, Safie Inc.

"Safie’s vision is "Create a better future with intelligent vision," and we have been empowering decision-making for people working onsite through video data. This strategic partnership with Ailytics will further accelerate the realization of the world we strive to build. Ailytics’ integrated AI platform stands out not only for detecting unsafe behaviors, but also for its ability to statistically visualize and quantify site-level safety performance. We will begin by tackling safety management, one of the key pain points at construction and manufacturing sites, and eventually establish a comprehensive support system that extends to process and progress management.

 

Together, Safie and Ailytics will rapidly deploy a wide range of AI models that deliver real-world utility. We invite you to watch what we build next."


About Ailytics Pte Ltd

Ailytics is an AI video analytics software company delivering smarter vision for industrial safety and productivity by leveraging on advanced computer vision to detect risks, improve compliance, and optimize operations across construction, ports, airports, and other heavy industry sectors.
